data.title: Quince Therapeutics Faces Nasdaq Listing Compliance Challenges
data.description:
An announcement from Quince Therapeutics ( (QNCX) ) is now available.

On August 31, 2026, Quince Therapeutics received a Nasdaq notice that, based on its June 30, 2026 Form 10-Q, the company reported negative stockholders’ equity of $35.3 million, falling short of the $10 million minimum required under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(b)(1)(A) for the Nasdaq Global Select Market. The notice does not immediately affect trading in QNCX shares, but Quince has until October 15, 2026 to submit a compliance plan and could receive up to 180 days from the notice date to restore equity above the threshold.

The company is evaluating options to regain compliance while pursuing an initial listing application under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5110(a that would move its shares to the Nasdaq Capital Market under the new name IRulya Therapeutics Inc. and ticker IRLA, contingent on stockholder and Nasdaq approvals. The developments highlight growing listing pressure on Quince and inject uncertainty for shareholders, as there is no assurance it will meet equity requirements, secure the new listing, or maintain compliance with other Nasdaq rules.
